_note: Fictional Messenger conversations for the demo shops, keyed by owner email. flag_reason = the chat was handed to the shop (AI paused, notification created). minutes_ago = when the customer's last message arrived. No real customer data.

messages.text: Apnader product ta ki kharap chilo, color uthe geche dhuye

I want a refund for my last order

ami manusher sathe kotha bolte chai
